STANDARD FEATURES
Power and Handling Driver Controls
MKT 3.7-liter Ti-VCT 24-valve V6 engine Intelligent Access with push-button start (2 key fob transmitters)
303 hp @ 6,500 rpm 279 lb.-ft. of torque @ 4,000 rpm Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals with memory
EPA-estimated fuel economy ratings1 Remote Start System
FWD 16 city/24 hwy/19 combined mpg (18.6-gal. capacity)
Tri-zone electronic automatic temperature control
MKT with GTDI 3.5-liter 24-valve GTDI V6 twin-turbocharged, direct-injection engine
Universal garage door opener
365 hp @ 5,700 rpm2 350 lb.-ft. of torque @ 3,500 rpm2
EPA-estimated fuel economy ratings1
Audio Systems
AWD 15 city/21 hwy/17 combined mpg (18.6-gal. capacity)
Lincoln Sound System with AM/FM stereo/single-CD player, MP3 capability and 10 speakers
6-speed SelectShift® automatic transmission with paddle activation
SiriusXM® Satellite Radio with 6-month trial subscription
Battery Management System
Compact spare wheel and tire
Interior
Electric Power-Assisted Steering (EPAS)
1st-row center floor console with armrest and 2 cupholders
Heavy-duty alternator (220-amp)
2nd-row manual side-window sunshades
Power, ventilated disc brakes with Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) and electronic brakeforce
12-volt powerpoints (4)
distribution (EBD)
110-volt power outlet in rear of 1st-row center floor console
Suspension: front, MacPherson strut, rear-facing L-shaped lower control arms; rear, multilink
Ambient lighting
independent with stamped-steel lower control arms
Auto-dimming rearview mirror
Torque Vectoring Control
Cabin particulate air filter
Driver-Assist Technology Cargo net
Automatic on/off headlamps Front door-sill scuff plates backlit with Lincoln script
Reverse Sensing System Genuine wood trim accents on instrument panel and doors (Prussian Burl or Brown Swirl Walnut)
SYNC® 3 with 8" color LCD capacitive touchscreen in center stack with swiping capability, 911 Assist,® Leather-wrapped shift knob with chrome accents
AppLink,® Apple CarPlay™ Support, Android Auto™, and 2 smart-charging USB ports Leather-wrapped steering wheel with genuine wood accent
Panoramic fixed-glass Vista Roof®
Exterior Power front and rear sunshades for fixed-glass roof
Acoustic-laminate windshield and front-door glass Power-tilt/-telescoping steering column with memory
Adaptive high-intensity discharge (HID) headlamps with auto high beams Power windows with one-touch-up/-down and global open/close
Chrome inserts on door handles
Dual exhaust with bright tips Seating
Easy Fuel® capless fuel filler 1st-row heated and cooled bucket seats with 12-way power adjustments, including power lumbar,
Fog lamps 4-way adjustable head restraints, and driver’s side memory
LED taillamps 2nd-row 60/40 split fold-flat bench seat with heated outboard seating and fold-down armrest
Power-adjustable, manually folding, heated sideview mirrors with memory, integrated blind spot mirrors, with dual cupholders (power release on 40 side)
security approach lamps, integrated LED turn signal indicators and auto-dimming driver’s side 3rd-row 50/50 split fold-flat bench seat
Power-open and -close liftgate with spoiler 7-passenger seating
Wipers: rain-sensing, speed-sensitive intermittent (front); 2-speed (rear) Bridge of Weir™ leather-trimmed seats for 1st and 2nd rows
